role.zh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO

why.en: Devin created the category of the 'AI software engineer'. Cognition then absorbed Windsurf and now runs a company where its own agent writes almost all the code.
why.zh: Devin 提出了「AI 软件工程师」这一产品类别。Cognition 随后整合 Windsurf 团队，如今公司自身几乎全部代码由自家 agent 编写。

title.en: AI coding agents shouldn't replace humans
title.zh: AI 编程 agent 不应该取代人

title.en: Great essay. Please take this seriously - would highly recommend reading up on the Hugging Face incident and others if you haven't already. Very glad to see agr
title.zh: Great essay. Please take this seriously - would highly recommend reading up on the Hugging Face incident and others if you haven't already. Very glad to see agr

note.en: Scott Wu endorses an essay's argument on AI industry safety practices, citing the Hugging Face incident as a cautionary precedent.
note.zh: Scott Wu认同一篇关于AI行业安全实践的文章观点，并以Hugging Face事件作为前车之鉴。

title.en: SWE-2 is live! Really proud of the work our research team put into this one. Our first model where we're seeing performance comparable to the frontier. Making i
title.zh: SWE-2 is live! Really proud of the work our research team put into this one. Our first model where we're seeing performance comparable to the frontier. Making i

note.en: Wu announced SWE-2, Cognition's first model reaching performance comparable to the frontier, made free for a month.
note.zh: 吴宣布SWE-2上线，这是Cognition首个性能可媲美前沿水平的模型，并限时一个月免费开放。

title.en: a16z backed my first company. Really excited for the chance to run it back with @pmarca and team!
title.zh: a16z backed my first company. Really excited for the chance to run it back with @pmarca and team!

note.en: Wu confirmed a16z is backing Cognition again, noting the firm also backed his first company.
note.zh: Scott Wu证实a16z再次投资Cognition，并提到该机构也曾投资过他的第一家公司。

title.en: This one feels special - a lot of folks on this list we've admired for years and now finally get to work with. Above all I'm grateful for the incredible team th
title.zh: This one feels special - a lot of folks on this list we've admired for years and now finally get to work with. Above all I'm grateful for the incredible team th

note.en: He reflects on Cognition's team growth, saying he's now working with people he's long admired and calling this moment 'special'.
note.zh: 他谈到Cognition团队的成长，表示如今能与长期敬佩的人共事，称这一刻“格外特别”。

title.en: Math Wars, GG Navier Stokes, Greg Brockman Joins | Dan Wright, Eric Seufert, Scott Wu, Sahir Jaggi, Andrew Borovsky, Harry Mellsop
title.zh: Math Wars, GG Navier Stokes, Greg Brockman Joins | Dan Wright, Eric Seufert, Scott Wu, Sahir Jaggi, Andrew Borovsky, Harry Mellsop

note.en: Scott Wu joined the TBPN roundtable alongside other founders to discuss the state of AI, including reactions to Greg Brockman joining the conversation.
note.zh: Scott Wu与其他创始人一同参加TBPN圆桌节目，讨论AI行业动态，包括对Greg Brockman加入讨论的反应。

title.en: Congrats to @ClementDelangue and the whole HF team! Really important work for the industry.
title.zh: Congrats to @ClementDelangue and the whole HF team! Really important work for the industry.

note.en: Congratulated Clement Delangue and the Hugging Face team, calling their work really important for the industry.
note.zh: 他祝贺 Clement Delangue 及 Hugging Face 团队，称他们的工作对行业意义重大。

title.en: This is not true. Huge respect for the SpaceX team but Cognition is not for sale and we haven't been talking.
title.zh: This is not true. Huge respect for the SpaceX team but Cognition is not for sale and we haven't been talking.

note.en: Publicly denied rumors that Cognition was in acquisition talks with SpaceX, calling the report untrue.
note.zh: 公开否认有关Cognition与SpaceX洽谈收购的传言，称报道不实。

title.en: At Cognition, one of our values is to go for it all: when faced with a tradeoff, pick the ambition-maximizing direction. When we launched Devin in 2024, we envi
title.zh: At Cognition, one of our values is to go for it all: when faced with a tradeoff, pick the ambition-maximizing direction. When we launched Devin in 2024, we envi

note.en: Marking Devin's launch anniversary, Wu described Cognition's guiding principle of picking the most ambitious path when facing tradeoffs.
note.zh: 值此Devin发布周年之际，Scott Wu阐述了Cognition在面临取舍时选择“最大化雄心”方向的核心价值观。

title.en: Incredible price/performance by the GPT-5.6 series on FrontierCode. All Devin users should see the cost decreases reflected automatically!
title.zh: Incredible price/performance by the GPT-5.6 series on FrontierCode. All Devin users should see the cost decreases reflected automatically!

note.en: Said GPT-5.6's price/performance gains would automatically lower costs for Devin users.
note.zh: 表示GPT-5.6系列的性价比提升将自动降低Devin用户的使用成本。

title.en: Inside the Fastest-Growing Category in AI: Scott Wu, CEO of $26B Cognition
title.zh: Inside the Fastest-Growing Category in AI: Scott Wu, CEO of $26B Cognition

note.en: An interview recorded in Paris around the RAISE AI Summit in which he describes how Cognition built Devin and Devin Desktop into the fastest-growing category in AI tooling.
note.zh: 他在巴黎 RAISE AI 峰会期间录制的访谈，讲述 Cognition 如何把 Devin 与 Devin Desktop 做成 AI 工具中增长最快的品类。

title.en: One year ago today, Cognition acquired Windsurf, capping off one of the crazier weekends in our company's history. The outline has been told many times: the fir
title.zh: One year ago today, Cognition acquired Windsurf, capping off one of the crazier weekends in our company's history. The outline has been told many times: the fir

note.en: Reflected on the one-year anniversary of Cognition's acquisition of Windsurf, recounting the chaotic weekend it came together.
note.zh: 回顾Cognition收购Windsurf一周年，讲述了那个促成交易的混乱周末。

title.en: Demand for inference compute will grow exponentially at least as fast as the METR curve grows (and arguably faster). Excited to have more great chips on the mar
title.zh: Demand for inference compute will grow exponentially at least as fast as the METR curve grows (and arguably faster). Excited to have more great chips on the mar

note.en: Argued inference compute demand will grow at least as fast as the METR capability curve, while congratulating chipmaker Etched.
note.zh: 他认为推理算力需求的增长速度至少将与METR能力曲线一样快，同时祝贺芯片公司Etched。

title.en: Model routing is a hot topic but there are two challenges to doing routing for coding agents: 1) Even if different models can pass the task, there are subtle di
title.zh: Model routing is a hot topic but there are two challenges to doing routing for coding agents: 1) Even if different models can pass the task, there are subtle di

note.en: Laid out why model routing is harder for coding agents than it looks, citing subtle behavioral differences between models.
note.zh: 阐述了为何编码智能体的模型路由比看起来更难，指出不同模型间存在细微的行为差异。

title.en: Scott Wu, Cognition
title.zh: Scott Wu, Cognition

note.en: A long-form conversation with David Senra tracing his path from childhood competitive programming to running the company behind Devin.
note.zh: 他与 David Senra 的长篇对话，回顾自己从少年时期的竞赛编程一路走到执掌 Devin 背后公司的历程。

title.en: A new top scorer just one day after our benchmark released! Especially strong on the hardest tasks: 13.4% -> 29.3% on FrontierCode Diamond compared to Opus 4
title.zh: A new top scorer just one day after our benchmark released! Especially strong on the hardest tasks: 13.4% -> 29.3% on FrontierCode Diamond compared to Opus 4

note.en: Noted a new model beat Cognition's FrontierCode Diamond benchmark just a day after release, jumping from 13.4% to 29.3% versus Opus 4.8.
note.zh: 指出一款新模型在Cognition的FrontierCode Diamond基准发布仅一天后就刷新纪录，相较Opus 4.8从13.4%跃升至29.3%。

title.en: SWE-Bench style grading has been the standard for years now - you ask the agent to solve an issue and then run its code on a pre-constructed unit test. The prob
title.zh: SWE-Bench style grading has been the standard for years now - you ask the agent to solve an issue and then run its code on a pre-constructed unit test. The prob

note.en: Critiqued SWE-Bench-style unit-test grading as an incomplete measure of whether an agent's code actually solves the underlying issue.
note.zh: 批评SWE-Bench式的单元测试评分方式，认为通过测试并不能完全说明智能体真正解决了潜在问题。

title.en: Measuring someone's productivity by their token usage is a horrible idea. Giving everyone the same fixed token budget isn't much better. So what's the right way
title.zh: Measuring someone's productivity by their token usage is a horrible idea. Giving everyone the same fixed token budget isn't much better. So what's the right way

note.en: Argued that measuring engineer productivity by token usage is misguided and described how Cognition is rethinking AI rollout metrics.
note.zh: 认为以token使用量衡量工程师生产力的做法有误，并介绍了Cognition重新思考AI推广指标的方式。

title.en: Standalone IDEs have about 6 months left to live. An interface for manually editing and refactoring doesn’t need to exist if you're not manually editing and ref
title.zh: Standalone IDEs have about 6 months left to live. An interface for manually editing and refactoring doesn’t need to exist if you're not manually editing and ref

note.en: Predicted standalone IDEs have roughly six months left as manual code editing gives way to AI-driven workflows.
note.zh: 预测随着手动编辑代码的方式被AI驱动的工作流取代，独立IDE的寿命大概只剩六个月。

title.en: I beat Minesweeper in 77 seconds! Devin now supports Windows VMs https://t.co/zVDGMjAox9 #DevinGotAWindowsPC
title.zh: I beat Minesweeper in 77 seconds! Devin now supports Windows VMs https://t.co/zVDGMjAox9 #DevinGotAWindowsPC

note.en: Announced Devin now supports Windows VMs, demoed by having it beat Minesweeper in 77 seconds.
note.zh: 宣布Devin现已支持Windows虚拟机，并以77秒通关扫雷作为演示。

title.en: thank you @colossusmag and thank you to @JeremySternLA for coming to visit the Cog office! to give my side of what seems to be the most controversial story of t
title.zh: thank you @colossusmag and thank you to @JeremySternLA for coming to visit the Cog office! to give my side of what seems to be the most controversial story of t

note.en: Gave his side of a widely discussed story about attending a Founders Fund gala, pushing back on the controversial framing.
note.zh: 就一则广受讨论的报道——他出席Founders Fund晚宴一事——给出了自己的说法，回应了具有争议性的报道角度。

title.en: Ep 147: Scott Wu & Russell Kaplan on the New Era of Software Abundance
title.zh: Ep 147: Scott Wu & Russell Kaplan on the New Era of Software Abundance

note.en: He and Cognition co-founder Russell Kaplan argue on American Optimist that AI agents will make expert software engineering ubiquitous rather than scarce.
note.zh: 他与 Cognition 联合创始人 Russell Kaplan 在 American Optimist 节目中提出，AI 智能体将让专家级软件工程从稀缺变为随处可得。

title.en: Excited for folks to try this out! There’s been a long-held assumption that “agentic” must mean “slow”. Now we have full agent search that runs at similar speed
title.zh: Excited for folks to try this out! There’s been a long-held assumption that “agentic” must mean “slow”. Now we have full agent search that runs at similar speed

note.en: He introduces Cognition's full agent search, arguing it breaks the assumption that agentic retrieval has to be slower than basic RAG.
note.zh: 他介绍 Cognition 的全智能体搜索，认为它打破了“智能体检索必然慢于基础 RAG”的固有假设。

title.en: How Devin replaces your junior engineers with infinite AI interns that never sleep | Scott Wu (Cognition CEO)
title.zh: How Devin replaces your junior engineers with infinite AI interns that never sleep | Scott Wu (Cognition CEO)

note.en: A working demo and discussion of how teams actually deploy Devin alongside human engineers, rather than as a replacement for them.
note.zh: 一场实机演示与讨论，说明团队在实际工作中如何让 Devin 与人类工程师协作，而非取代他们。

title.en: Cognition CEO Scott Wu on acquiring Windsurf, AI replacing engineers, and the Moneyball-ification of everything
title.zh: Cognition CEO Scott Wu on acquiring Windsurf, AI replacing engineers, and the Moneyball-ification of everything

note.en: An interview with John Collison covering the weekend acquisition of Windsurf, what AI does to engineering headcount, and how he thinks about hiring.
note.zh: 他与 John Collison 的访谈，谈及周末之内完成的 Windsurf 收购、AI 对工程团队规模的影响，以及他的招聘思路。

title.en: Wave 12! Much bigger one than Wave 11 - starting to incorporate a lot more Devin secret sauce into the Windsurf IDE experience. Give it a try!
title.zh: Wave 12! Much bigger one than Wave 11 - starting to incorporate a lot more Devin secret sauce into the Windsurf IDE experience. Give it a try!

note.en: He ships Windsurf Wave 12, the release that begins folding Devin's agent capabilities into the Windsurf IDE after the acquisition.
note.zh: 他发布 Windsurf Wave 12——收购之后首次将 Devin 的智能体能力大规模融入 Windsurf IDE 的版本。

title.en: 20VC: Cognition CEO Scott Wu on Acquiring Windsurf: The Process, The Deal, The Rationale | Did Google Overlook a Goldmine in the Core Asset and Did Founders Leave a Sinking Ship | How Cursor and Cognition Deal with Ever Increasing Reliance on Anthropic
title.zh: 20VC: Cognition CEO Scott Wu on Acquiring Windsurf: The Process, The Deal, The Rationale | Did Google Overlook a Goldmine in the Core Asset and Did Founders Leave a Sinking Ship | How Cursor and Cognition Deal with Ever Increasing Reliance on Anthropic

posts.source: The Twenty Minute VC (20VC): Venture C…

note.en: His fullest public account of the Windsurf acquisition — the process, the deal terms and the rationale — given days after it closed.
note.zh: 交易完成数日后，他对收购 Windsurf 的过程、条款与动机所做的最完整公开说明。

title.en: It's been great working with the teams at Goldman Sachs. Proud of Devin for landing one of the hardest jobs on Wall Street :)
title.zh: It's been great working with the teams at Goldman Sachs. Proud of Devin for landing one of the hardest jobs on Wall Street :)

note.en: He announces that Devin is deployed with engineering teams at Goldman Sachs, one of Cognition's most cited enterprise references.
note.zh: 他宣布 Devin 已进入高盛的工程团队使用，这是 Cognition 最常被引用的企业客户案例之一。

title.en: Ep 115: Scott Wu, Devin, and a Trillion-Dollar Opportunity
title.zh: Ep 115: Scott Wu, Devin, and a Trillion-Dollar Opportunity

note.en: An interview a year after the Devin demo on how the product went global and why he sees autonomous software engineering as a trillion-dollar market.
note.zh: Devin 演示一年后的访谈，讲述产品如何走向全球，以及他为何认为自主软件工程是万亿美元级的市场。

title.en: Inside Devin: The world’s first autonomous AI engineer that's set to write 50% of its company’s code by end of year | Scott Wu (CEO and co-founder of Cognition)
title.zh: Inside Devin: The world’s first autonomous AI engineer that's set to write 50% of its company’s code by end of year | Scott Wu (CEO and co-founder of Cognition)

note.en: He walks through how Devin works internally and states the goal of having it write half of Cognition's own code by year end.
note.zh: 他详细介绍 Devin 的内部运作方式，并提出年内让它写下 Cognition 自身一半代码的目标。

title.en: Scott Wu - Building Cognition
title.zh: Scott Wu - Building Cognition

posts.source: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Sh…

note.en: An Invest Like the Best episode on the first year of Cognition: building an applied AI lab around a single agent product.
note.zh: Invest Like the Best 节目，讲述 Cognition 的第一年——如何围绕单一智能体产品打造一家应用型 AI 实验室。

title.en: Cognition’s Scott Wu on how Devin, the AI software engineer, will work for you
title.zh: Cognition’s Scott Wu on how Devin, the AI software engineer, will work for you

note.en: His first major podcast appearance after the Devin launch, explaining why he believes an AI software engineer creates work for human engineers rather than removing it.
note.zh: Devin 发布后他的首次重要播客访谈，解释他为何认为 AI 软件工程师会为人类工程师创造工作，而非取代他们。

title.en: 027 - Scott Wu (CTO of Lunchclub) on In-Person Interaction
title.zh: 027 - Scott Wu (CTO of Lunchclub) on In-Person Interaction

note.en: Early appearance by Wu, then CTO of Lunchclub, discussing the value of in-person interaction — years before he co-founded Cognition.
note.zh: Wu在创立Cognition之前,以Lunchclub联合创始人兼CTO身份接受采访,探讨线下人际互动的价值。

title.en: $1B Series D at a $26B valuation
title.zh: 10 亿美元 D 轮，估值 260 亿美元

body.en: Co-led by Lux Capital, General Catalyst and 8VC at a $25B pre-money. Annualized revenue grew from ~$37M to $492M in a year; total raised over $2.5B.
body.zh: Lux Capital、General Catalyst 与 8VC 联合领投，投前估值 250 亿美元。年化收入一年内从约 3700 万增至 4.92 亿美元；累计融资超 25 亿美元。

title.en: In talks to raise at $40B+ on a $1B run rate
title.zh: 以 10 亿美元年化收入洽谈 400 亿美元以上估值新轮

body.en: Wu says Devin now writes roughly 95% of Cognition's own code, up from 89% at the Series D.
body.zh: Wu 称 Devin 现已编写 Cognition 约 95% 的代码，D 轮时为 89%。

title.en: Latest Cognition Raise Boosts Under 30 Alum Scott Wu’s Net Worth To $2.7 Billion
title.zh: Latest Cognition Raise Boosts Under 30 Alum Scott Wu’s Net Worth To $2.7 Billion

body.en: Cognition's latest funding round pushed Scott Wu's net worth to $2.7 billion, per Forbes.
body.zh: 据福布斯报道，Cognition最新一轮融资使Scott Wu的身家达到27亿美元。

title.en: Scott Wu Says Devin Writes 95% of Cognition’s Code — and He’s Betting $2.5 Billion That Independence Beats Joining a Lab
title.zh: Scott Wu Says Devin Writes 95% of Cognition’s Code — and He’s Betting $2.5 Billion That Independence Beats Joining a Lab

body.en: Wu said Devin now writes roughly 95% of Cognition's own code and defended staying independent instead of joining a larger lab.
body.zh: Scott Wu 表示 Devin 已承担 Cognition 约95%的代码编写，并说明为何选择保持独立而不并入大厂实验室。

title.en: Cognition’s Scott Wu says AI coding agents shouldn’t replace humans
title.zh: Cognition’s Scott Wu says AI coding agents shouldn’t replace humans

body.en: Interview published as Cognition raised $1 billion at a $26 billion valuation, in which Wu argued coding agents should assist engineers rather than replace them.
body.zh: 在 Cognition 以260亿美元估值完成10亿美元融资之际接受采访，Scott Wu 主张编程智能体应辅助而非取代工程师。
